title: Irish Potato Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole perfect for cold evenings. It combines the flavors of Ireland with the simplicity of a potato casserole.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the diced onion over medium heat until softened.
In a separate bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, shredded cheese, dried oregano, and sautéed onion.
Transfer the potato mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk and a pinch of salt.
Pour the milk mixture over the potato mixture, making sure all potatoes are coated.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
